.name: Look up a friend's achievements for one Steam game
.note: Read a friend's visible achievement progress for one Steam game.
.description: Read visible achievements for one friend and one game. Returns unlocked count, total achievement count, completion percentage, and details. If only a display name is known, look up Steam friends first and ask the user to confirm multiple matches. Use Steam store search to identify the AppID from a game name. Use nextStart for the next page of details.
.parameters.steamId: The target friend's SteamID64 as a string.
.parameters.appId: Integer AppID of one Steam game.
.parameters.start: Zero-based offset. Continue with the previous result's nextStart.
.parameters.limit: 1 to 100 entries per page. The default is 25.
